text:
maya-dev: Heads-up — canary is seeing a compile surge after today's 08:15 deploy. Compile jobs spiked ~3x for certain kernels, latency up ~200ms per request. Anyone seen this?

jordan-rt: I saw that too. Autopick telemetry shows a routing change: small-batch requests are being routed to the 'fused-gemm' kernel which triggers JIT compile more often. :thinking_face:

samir-sre: CI perf alerts flagged higher median tail for canary. I started a bisect across the last 5 merges touching runtime-autopick configs, starting with PR 4127.

olivia-ml: Might be the heuristic weight change we rolled last week (it favors throughput at the expense of compile-cost). Recommend we revert that weight change in canary immediately.

maya-dev: Repro snippet in canary: 
```bash
# query compile events
curl -s http://metrics.internal/compiles?env=canary&kernel=fused-gemm | jq '.events | length'
```
Getting ~850 compile events in the last 10m.

lee-eng: I pushed a fix to kernel-autopick scoring yesterday that normalized latency vs compile cost. Could be an unintended side effect. PR: git@repo:eng/runtime#4199

jordan-rt: @lee-eng can you bisect your patch locally against the previous heuristic? If it's the cause we should hotfix/revert.

lee-eng: On it. Spinning up a local canary with previous weights now. ETA ~12m.

ci-bot: CI alert: perf-regression-detect triggered on canary (median latency +15%). Link: https://ci.internal/runs/9876 :alarm_clock:

samir-sre: If we confirm it's autopick we should also throttle compile concurrency and enable a more aggressive KV cache fallback to stop compile storms while we patch.

olivia-ml: KV cache debug shows a lot of collisions on namespace 'kernel-profile-v2' — many cache entries are being invalidated and not hit, which forces recompile. That could be amplifying the autopick behavior.

maya-dev: Good catch. @samir-sre can you enable kvcache debug and capture stack traces for evictions? Also hold the rollout — don't promote to prod until we have a fix.

jordan-rt: Rollout paused by canary-failure policy. Not letting the rest through. :no_entry_sign:

lee-eng: Reverting PR 4199 now, opening revert PR and will push a targeted fix to reduce autopick preference for fused-gemm on small batches.

maya-dev: Thanks — after the revert, monitor compile events for the next 20m. If compile rate drops and latency recovers we'll schedule a proper patch + postmortem. :pray:
